verdict:
NO ENTRY WHILE THE YORKVILLE MACHINE IS LIVE - and this name is the batch's cleanest illustration of why some gates must be events, never prices.

THE SCREEN PREMISE DECOMPOSES INTO TWO ARTIFACTS. The -69.1% dd52 is measured off the $10.52 October-2025 Trump/DOE government-stake squeeze print. Decomposed: $10.52 to $5.99 is the squeeze round-tripping (a screen artifact, not a dislocation); $5.99 to $3.38 is the real six-month move, and it coincides exactly with shares 314.3M to 363.0M and debt $536M to ~$1.31B pro-forma. Roughly half the excess-drawdown that fired this event is a measurement artifact of a policy peak; the other half is the funding mechanism working as designed. Neither half is a mispricing.

THE INSTRUMENT IS THE DISCLOSURE. A company reporting ~$1.3B of cash and ~$1.02B of undrawn DOE capacity does not issue a $150M convertible to Yorkville converting at the LOWER of $4.56 or 95% of the lowest 5-day VWAP, floor $1.63 reducible to $0.65, coupon stepping 5% to 7.5% to 15% on floor-breach or registration failure. Distress-priced paper on a marketed-strong balance sheet means the strength is trapped: DOE advances are project-restricted and cannot fund corporate overhead or LAC's own JV equity calls. The triage's reflexivity arithmetic is sound and worth preserving: at ~$3.21 conversion the $150M prints ~46.7M shares (~13% of o/s); below roughly $2.07 average conversion the ~19.99% exchange cap binds, forcing capped cash repayment ($35M max while Orion's notes are out) or a vote, and tripping the 15% coupon. Every conversion sells into the tape and lowers the VWAP that sets the next conversion. Add ~18.3M DOE penny warrants and $181.5M of unused ATM.

WHAT IS GENUINELY INTACT: the project. $1.785B capitalized against an unchanged $2.93B estimate, engineering >95%, procurement >80%, mechanical completion still late-2027, unchanged QoQ. The cohort narrative 'the project fails' is REFUTED. The narrative the tape is pricing - 'you will fund it and own progressively less of it' - is CONFIRMED by the share register. The triage's classification discipline (follow the confirmed claim) is exactly right.

GATE DESIGN - THE DOUBLE SELF-TRIGGER. Prompt-mandated carrier check: LAC's tape is high-beta to lithium ($18,160/t vs the technical report's $24,000/t deck), AND it carries a mechanical reflexive seller (the VWAP-reset convert) that converts weakness into supply into more weakness. A price gate here is self-triggering TWICE OVER: a fill arrives either because lithium fell (thesis-worse: project economics compress) or because Yorkville is printing (thesis-worse: the dilution spiral is running). There is no price at which a fill is good news. EVENT GATES ONLY - the triage's tripwire list is correct and I adopt it as the gate set.
blue_ruling: TRIAGE-ONLY - no benches convened. Court-worthiness 5/10, below threshold, and I concur: the sizing answer (flat while a live VWAP-reset convertible can print into the tape) is mechanically determined; a court would refine tripwires, not change the decision.
reopen_gates: EVENT (first and dated): the Yorkville resale S-3 goes EFFECTIVE and the first conversion notices print - converts the undated overhang into a watchable flow; track conversion pace vs the ~72.6M-share exchange cap. Entry is only discussable once the debenture is substantially converted, repaid, or capped out.
DATA: two consecutive prints with share count flat within 2% AND no ATM draw - the register itself is the thesis; flat shares = the funding mechanism has stopped eating the equity.
EVENT: a 4th DOE advance taken WITHOUT an accompanying equity or convertible raise - would falsify the 'corporate-level gap' read that makes the Yorkville paper so informative.

DATA: unchanged $2.93B total capex estimate and unchanged late-2027 mechanical completion at the Q3 print - keeps the intact-project leg intact; a capex bump while the convert is live is the compounding-bad branch.

CARRIER: lithium carbonate back above ~$24,000/t (the technical-report deck) would re-open the economics leg - but only in combination with the share-count gate; price without register discipline is still uninvestable.
DATA (pre-court hygiene): re-pull the quarterly cash/debt/share series from the 10-Q directly - the triage's series came from a secondary aggregator and is flagged as not-yet-load-bearing for sizing.
adjudicator_note: batch-6 draft RATIFIED 2026-08-17; every proposed price gate re-checked against the beta-carrier self-trigger rule before arming (LTBR anchor self-updates on net cash; LAC carries NO bare price gate; RBLX/INTR/JMIA gates kept as review-only triggers, never entries)
